fields.name: Device Issue
fields.description: Hardware problems — cracked screens, battery issues, charging faults

fields.name: App Error
fields.description: eCHIS, Dashboard or registry app crashes, freezes or unexpected behaviour

fields.name: Password Reset
fields.description: CHP or CHA locked out or forgotten password

fields.name: eCHIS Logout
fields.description: eCHIS keeps logging users out unexpectedly

fields.name: Sync Error
fields.description: Data not syncing to server — offline records stuck

fields.name: Connectivity Issue
fields.description: Network, data bundles or internet access problems

fields.name: Missing Data
fields.description: Submitted records not appearing in dashboard or reports

fields.name: Other
fields.description: Any issue not covered by the categories above
